spine: 1. 症狀：Security Insights 掃描卡在每秒約 10 次，backlog 累積數百萬筆事件、API 頻繁逾時、process 崩潰——目標是不加機器把吞吐量拉十倍。
2. 假設一（Kafka 消費端）：一則慢訊息阻塞整個 partition（head-of-line blocking），證據是 15/30 partition 落後；解法是批次消費＋每訊息開 goroutine，再拆 slow/fast lane。
3. 假設二（資料庫寫入）：每個 issue 一次 round trip，最大批量 50 萬筆＝單一 API call 裡五十萬次往返、查詢與交易；解法是 UNNEST／COPY 混合。
4. 假設三（API 跨洲延遲）：primary DB 在 Portland，API 卻在 Portland 與 Amsterdam active-active，Amsterdam 平均一次呼叫近 3 秒、Portland 才 10 ms；解法是改 active-passive 讓 active API 跟著 primary。
5. 收尾的排程改寫：zone 獨立於 account 排程、隨機化 last_scheduled_at、加入 adaptive rate limiting，攤平排程造成的尖峰。
6. 結果：尖峰排程時穩定每秒 120+ 次掃描，超過十倍目標，且不靠加 pod 或 partition——靠讀 code、SQL、log、metric 找瓶頸。

perspective.mechanism: 一條訊息佇列／一個跨區資料庫呼叫／一個 N+1 寫入迴圈，各自如何形成吞吐量上限；瓶頸不是「機器不夠」而是順序消費、跨洲 RTT、每筆一次 round trip 這三種結構問題。
perspective.tradeoff: 不加硬體的代價是要逐層量測與改寫——批次消費換來亂序、UNNEST/COPY 換來分支判斷、active-passive 換掉 Amsterdam 的就近服務；每個修復都犧牲某種簡單性換吞吐量。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師遇到 Kafka consumer lag、ORM N+1 寫入、跨區資料庫呼叫時，可以照同一條偵查路線：先看 partition lag 與按地區拆分的 API 延遲，再決定動哪一層。

notes.quote: we were executing around 10 scans per second
notes.interpretation: 原始吞吐量基線，作者用 around 輕度 hedge。

notes.quote: increase our scanning throughput by around 10x on average – from 10 scans per second to 100 per second
notes.interpretation: 十倍目標，from 10 to 100 是設定的目標值。

notes.quote: Today, Security Insights sustains over 120 scans per second during peak scheduling, exceeding our 10x improvement goal
notes.interpretation: 最終達成值，超過 120/秒，超過十倍目標。

notes.quote: perform[s] regular scans for all accounts, zones, and DNS records, looking for potential security risks and misconfigurations
notes.interpretation: 系統做什麼：對 account/zone/DNS record 定期掃描找風險與錯誤設定。

notes.quote: millions of events were filling up our backlog waiting to be processed
notes.interpretation: 症狀一：backlog 累積數百萬事件。

notes.quote: our API was frequently timing out
notes.interpretation: 症狀二：API 頻繁逾時。

notes.quote: our processes were crashing
notes.interpretation: 症狀三：process 崩潰。

notes.quote: Messages that are slow to process block the consumer from progressing to the next message
notes.interpretation: head-of-line blocking 的機制描述。

notes.quote: Although we can only consume messages in order, there is nothing stopping us from consuming multiple messages at once.
notes.interpretation: 突破點：順序消費不妨礙一次拿多筆。

notes.quote: We changed our checkers to consume messages in batches, processing each message in a separate goroutine.
notes.interpretation: Kafka 消費端第一個修復：批次消費＋每訊息一個 goroutine。

notes.quote: We opted for a very simple approach: splitting our consumer groups and checkers in two – the 'slow lane' and the 'fast lane'.
notes.interpretation: 第二個修復：consumer group 拆成 slow lane / fast lane。

notes.quote: Exactly 15 partitions can be seen lagging behind (the lines that reach or approach zero later than around 03/10 03:00). This is because the load balancer splits traffic evenly between our API endpoints.
notes.interpretation: 證據：30 個 partition 裡剛好 15 個落後，因為 load balancer 平均分流。

notes.quote: for each issue: make a round trip to the database per insight. With a maximum observed size of 500,000, this was half a million round trips, queries, and transactions in a single API call.
notes.interpretation: 資料庫假設：每個 issue 一次 round trip，最大 50 萬筆＝單一 API call 五十萬次往返。

notes.quote: We settled on a hybrid approach: Using UNNEST when the number of issues was below a threshold; Using COPY when the number of issues exceeded this threshold
notes.interpretation: 資料庫修復：低於門檻用 UNNEST，超過用 COPY 的混合策略。

notes.quote: Our primary database is located in Portland, Oregon. Our API, however, was running active-active in both Portland and Amsterdam. Even at the speed of light, the round-trip latency between Portland and Amsterdam would be 50 milliseconds.
notes.interpretation: API 假設的根因：primary DB 在 Portland，API 卻 active-active 在兩地，光速下 RTT 就要 50 ms。

notes.quote: Our average API call completed in 10 ms in Portland, but almost 3 seconds in Amsterdam!
notes.interpretation: 證據：同一個 API call 在 Portland 平均 10 ms，Amsterdam 將近 3 秒。

notes.quote: we switched our API to active-passive, ensuring the active API followed our primary database.
notes.interpretation: API 修復：改 active-passive，讓 active API 跟著 primary DB。

notes.quote: Schedule zones independently of accounts: each zone gets its own last_scheduled_at field.
notes.interpretation: 排程修復一：zone 獨立於 account 排程，各有自己的 last_scheduled_at。

notes.quote: Randomize the last_scheduled_at time for existing accounts and zones.
notes.interpretation: 排程修復二：隨機化既有 account/zone 的 last_scheduled_at。

notes.quote: Introduce adaptive rate limiting for scan scheduling.
notes.interpretation: 排程修復三：為掃描排程加入 adaptive rate limiting。

notes.quote: By looking closely at our code, SQL queries, logs, and metrics, we were able to increase our capacity without simply adding more pods or partitions.
notes.interpretation: 方法論收尾：靠讀 code/SQL/log/metric，而非加 pod 或 partition。

notes.quote: We increased scanning throughput for Security Insights by more than 10x, enabled security insights for millions of customers, and doubled our scanning frequency for all customers.
notes.interpretation: 總結成果：吞吐量超過十倍、為數百萬客戶開通、所有客戶掃描頻率加倍。
